summary: Tested the Pulse parts price list import (21,174 rows into Pulse Fitness Ltd svc_parts), hiding prices from engineers, quote auto-fill pricing from the price list and parts requests, and the service-report PDF falling back to resolution_notes. Backend: 13 tests, 10 passed, 3 failed. UI: Parts Catalogue checked as owner and as engineer. Follow-up booking was not re-tested, as instructed.

critical.issue: Engineers still get list_price and cost here. _hide_prices was only added to /svc/parts/catalogue. The engineer PartsTab search calls this endpoint, so engineer prices are not fully hidden. routes/svc/parts.py list_parts uses projection {_id:0}.

minor.issue: The new parts-request fallback also counts further_parts_required requests (parts for the next visit). Until a follow-up is booked these stay on the original case, so a chargeable original job gets billed for parts that were never fitted. Reproduced: completed case + 1 further_parts_required request gave a £10.45 part line. Fix: exclude source=further_parts_required, or only count fulfilled/issued requests.

The upsert $sets cost and list_price even when they are 0. Any manual cost or sell price an operator entered for a matching SKU is overwritten every time a new price-list file version is bundled. About 4.5k rows have Sales Price 0 and about 9.4k have Average Buying Price 0.
Engineers still see list_price_gbp on allocations (EngineerJobDetailV2 lines 3243-3248 show £ totals) and van-stock sell values. Not covered by the new engineer price hiding.

ui_bugs.issue: list_price is now left out for engineers, but the page renders (p.list_price || 0).toFixed(2), so every part shows a misleading £0.00. Hide the price column when list_price is undefined.

This bug was already there, but the line touched in this change sits right on it. runSearch calls GET /svc/parts with params {q} and reads r.data.items. The backend expects 'search' and returns {parts,count}, so engineer search results are always empty and the search term is ignored. Use /svc/parts/catalogue?search= (items, prices hidden) or fix the param and key.

action_items: Hide list_price and cost for engineers in GET /api/svc/parts (or move PartsTab onto /svc/parts/catalogue)
Fix the PartsTab search contract: params.search instead of q, and r.data.parts or the catalogue's items
PartsCatalogue: don't show £0.00 when list_price is missing for engineers
auto-fill: exclude further_parts_required (next-visit) parts requests from billing on the original case
Consider not overwriting existing operator cost/list_price with 0 from the price list
critical_code_review_comments: billing.auto_fill: the parts_requests query has no org filter. It is safe because the case is already org-scoped, but add **of for consistency.
billing.auto_fill: the comment about the allocated_parts fallback now sits above the new parts-request block, which is misleading.

parts_price_list: 'Actual Quantity' is ignored, which is fine. The seed only matches orgs that exist at boot and are named ^Pulse Fitness with is_operator_company. The marker is per file digest, so it is correctly idempotent (verified it returns 0).
backfill_engineer_reports ran at boot (204 svc_cases backfilled, 0 bfpo PPM). It is guarded by $exists:false, so it is idempotent.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (owner catalogue shows prices OK; engineer catalogue shows £0.00)
